description: Takes either one status word from a purchasing or ERP system (for example 'in approval', 'returned', 'GR posted', 'payment block') or a list of cases with status and date. For one status it returns the plain meaning, who acts now, the next step and the usual time in that step. For a list it returns where the cases stand by phase, the cases sitting longer than usual (red), the cases waiting for the requester rather than purchasing and status words it does not know (yellow). Fifteen fixed phases from created to paid, German and English keywords, no AI, nothing stored. For the full order-to-payment chain per order use order_to_payment_status. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

as_of.description: Optional: reference date YYYY-MM-DD. Default today (Europe/Berlin).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: Optional list, one row per case: id, description, status, since (date of the last change), requester. German column names work too (nummer, beschreibung, status, seit, anforderer).

status.description: One status word or phrase to explain. Use this or rows.

name: explain_status
title: Status translator: what a purchasing status means in plain words, who acts now, and which cases are stuck
